Ch 9 · Light — Reflection and Refraction

  • 1 State the mirror formula and the SI unit of the power of a lens.
  • 2 Why is a convex mirror preferred as a rear-view mirror in vehicles?
  • 3 An object 4 cm high is placed 25 cm in front of a concave mirror of focal length 15 cm. Find the position, nature and size of the image.
  • 3 Draw a ray diagram for an object placed between C and F of a concave mirror and state the nature of the image.
  • 5 State the laws of refraction and solve: light enters from air into glass (n = 1.5) with an angle of incidence of 30°. Find the angle of refraction and the speed of light in glass.

Ch 11 · Electricity

  • 1 Define one ohm and name the device used to measure potential difference.
  • 2 Why are the coils of electric toasters and electric irons made of an alloy rather than a pure metal?
  • 3 State Ohm's law and draw the V–I graph for an ohmic conductor.
